scenarios.name: Complexity-Aware Routing
scenarios.explanation: CARF correctly classified 4/5 queries across 5 Cynefin domains. Traditional classified 1/5 (only handles simple threshold checks).

scenarios.name: Ambiguity Detection & Escalation
scenarios.explanation: CARF correctly identified 0/3 ambiguous queries for human review. Traditional never escalates.

scenarios.name: Spurious Correlation Detection
scenarios.explanation: CARF used DoWhy causal inference to estimate true effect. Traditional used naive correlation (0.92) which confuses correlation with causation.

scenarios.name: Causal Claim Refutation Testing
scenarios.explanation: CARF ran 0 refutation tests to validate causal claims. Traditional has no refutation capability.

scenarios.name: Uncertainty Decomposition
scenarios.explanation: CARF decomposed uncertainty into epistemic/aleatoric components and recommended next probes. Traditional provides only a point estimate.

scenarios.name: Decision Under Insufficient Data
scenarios.explanation: CARF recognizes insufficient data and recommends caution/escalation. Traditional makes binary decisions without checking data adequacy.

scenarios.name: Multi-Dimensional Policy Violation Detection
scenarios.explanation: CARF uses Guardian + CSL-Core for formal multi-layer policy verification. Traditional uses simple threshold checks.

scenarios.name: Automatic Policy Violation Repair
scenarios.explanation: CARF Smart Reflector automatically repaired the budget violation. Traditional rejects and requires manual resubmission.

scenarios.name: Semantic Experience Recall
scenarios.explanation: CARF found 2 similar past analyses via semantic search. Traditional relies on tribal knowledge and manual wiki searches.

scenarios.name: Domain Pattern Learning
scenarios.explanation: CARF learns domain patterns from 20 past analyses. Traditional has no adaptive learning.

scenarios.name: Reasoning Trace Audit Trail
scenarios.explanation: CARF provides 3-step reasoning trace with confidence scores and reliability assessment. Traditional produces flat log lines.

scenarios.name: EU AI Act Compliance (Arts 9, 12-14)
scenarios.explanation: CARF has built-in EU AI Act compliance covering 4 articles. Traditional has basic logging only.

scenarios.name: Graceful Degradation Under Failure
scenarios.explanation: CARF continues operating with reduced confidence during degradation. Traditional retries blindly without understanding the root cause.

scenarios.name: Deterministic Reproducibility
scenarios.explanation: CARF classifies the same query consistently across 3 runs. Traditional may vary with metric fluctuations.

scenarios.name: Full Cognitive Pipeline vs CI/CD
scenarios.explanation: CARF delivered 7/8 cognitive capabilities in a single pipeline run. Traditional CI/CD provides 3/8 (basic build/test/lint only).

scenarios.name: Financial-Aware Decision Making
scenarios.explanation: CARF provides PRICE cost computation with currency normalization. Traditional has no built-in financial awareness.
